description: Runs a brand's organic social: how each platform works now, a strategy per platform and two weeks of posts in the brand's or a person's real voice. Use when a marketer says "run organic social for my brand", "fill my social calendar", "plan two weeks of posts", "grow my X / LinkedIn / Instagram / TikTok", "ghostwrite my founder's posts", "which platforms should we be on?", "plan the social for our launch", "a TikTok or Reel script to shoot on my phone", "tear down @x's account", or "my accounts went quiet". The marketer posts by hand; nothing is posted or scheduled. Not for a standalone post or repurposing one piece — use make-content.
